route_results.reason: Tender, award and commercial-order confirmation are already terminal in the accepted major-contract branch and Campaign167. Acceptance, payment, retention, dispute and completion are bounded by Campaign200. Selecting only government customers, a tender portal, buyer role or another milestone is a prohibited source, entity-role, cohort or field rescue.

The Eastmoney government-subsidy disclosure-intensity branch already freezes public-support identity, title classification, timing, count and freshness. Replacing announcement with application, approval, disbursement, milestone or clawback fields is a lifecycle and field variant of the same external-support mechanism.

Campaign166 already freezes product-safety incidents, recalls and remediation, and Campaign184 explicitly rejects warranty, recall and defect-remediation relabeling against Campaign166 and Campaign170. Authority, product class, remedy stage or closure status cannot reopen that terminal domain.

Campaign183 already freezes outbound and inbound licenses, technology transfer, patent family and ownership, opposition, validity, expiry, termination and reversion. Trademark, copyright, assignment, pledge or jurisdiction choices are right-type, instrument and source variants rather than a new mechanism.

Campaign167 already freezes capacity commissioning, Campaign178 owner-side capital projects and productive-asset readiness, Campaign179 facility operating-right validity, and Campaign200 project progress, acceptance and completion. Construction permit, occupancy, commissioning, suspension or closure merely selects a stage or authority inside those terminal facility and project lifecycles.

Campaign186 already freezes fleet asset identity, acquisition, charter or use, availability, maintenance and disposal, while Campaign216 freezes vehicle production, registration, warranty, service, recall and scrappage. Corporate ownership, road rather than maritime vehicles, inspection authority or telematics is an entity-role, asset-class and source substitution.

Campaign170 already freezes complaints, service resolution, satisfaction, returns, warranty and retention outcomes; Campaign199 freezes case intake, response, escalation, corrective action, reopening and closure. A regulator hotline, mediation platform, dispute class, remedy or closure clock is a channel or event-state variant.

decision.reason: Every frozen route is already covered by an immutable terminal mechanism frontier. The priority selection rule therefore stops Campaign276 before formula, direction, source fields, rows or values.
decision.next_safe_work: Campaign277 may freeze a new finite concept-only catalog before targeted inventory. It must not rescue any Campaign276 route through a sibling provider, entity role, jurisdiction, field, metric, window, threshold, direction or incomplete source.
